# Local browser dependencies

- FullCalendar standard bundle, Luxon 3 plugin, Chinese locale: 6.1.21. MIT license. https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar
- Luxon: 3.7.2. MIT license. https://github.com/moment/luxon

Original distribution headers are retained. Download URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in manifest.json.
Reproduce assets with `scripts/vendor_calendar.py`. The running app uses these local files, not remote CDNs.
